how_to_tell_apart: Lithuanian and Latvian share a Baltic look, but the letters ė and ų are Lithuanian, while Latvian uses ģ, ķ, ļ and ņ instead. Word-level cues include aš, jūs, ačiū, prašau, laba diena, viso gero, šiandien, rytoj, kad, ką and gydytojas. Latvian would show es, paldies, lūdzu, šodien and rīt. The conjunction ir appears in both and is not diagnostic; Polish is a neighbour in the region but its pronunciation and diacritics (ł, ń, ś) are different.
